item.title: Collect a repaired bicycle
item.context_text: A shop has fixed the back brake on your bicycle. You need to arrange collection without missing work.
item.objective_text: Explain who will collect the bicycle and how they can identify it.
item.target_grammar: Will for arrangements. Could I for a polite question.
success_conditions: Explain who will collect the bicycle and how they can identify it.

children.title: Check the details
children.instructions: Read the message and use its details to answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
CYCLE WORKSHOP
Your bicycle is ready. Collection on Friday is from noon to 6 pm. Saturday collection is before 11 am. Someone else can collect it for you with the repair number. Your number is 284. Please pay the 75,000 som balance at the counter.

questions.prompt: What does your brother need to collect the bicycle for you?
options: Your old ticket for the bus
questions.explanation: The notice says a different person can collect it using the repair number, which is 284.

questions.prompt: Which time works if your brother can go only on Saturday?
questions.explanation: The Saturday window ends at 11 am. The Friday hours do not apply.

children.title: Send the collection details
children.instructions: Ask your brother to collect it on Saturday. Give him the number and confirm the amount to pay.
children.prompt_text: Brother: I can go first thing on Saturday. What do I need?
children.goal: Send the repair number and the balance.
children.model_answer: Thanks! Can you get my bike before 11 on Saturday? The repair number is 284. There is 75,000 som to pay at the counter.

children.title: Check which brake was repaired
children.instructions: You are at the counter. Give the repair number and ask whether the back brake was fixed.
children.prompt_text: Mechanic: What can I do for you?
children.goal: Identify the bicycle and check the completed work.
children.model_answer: I'm collecting the bike for repair number 284. Could you tell me if you fixed the back brake?
